entities.summary: William Kelleher is an Irish politician who has been a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) from Ireland for the South constituency since July 2019. He is a member of Fianna Fáil, part of Renew Europe. He was a Teachta Dála (TD) for the Cork North-Central constituency from 1997 to 2019 and a Senator as a Taoiseach's nominee from 1993 to 1997. He was a Minister of State from 2007 to 2011.
